nodes.label: Touch Icon SVG (Fire/Flame)
nodes.description: Bootstrap Icons 'bi-fire' flame icon used as touch/app icon for KFV Freising. Rendered at 16x16px with a bold red fill (#ec0928), representing fire and the fire department brand identity. The flame shape is a single path element with the KFV accent/fire-red color, consistent with the site design system.

nodes.label: Fire Red Color #ec0928
nodes.description: The hex color #ec0928 used as fill in the touch icon, matching the KFV Freising brand fire-red accent color (--fire-red CSS custom property).

nodes.label: Bootstrap Icons Library (bi-fire)
nodes.description: The icon is derived from Bootstrap Icons (class bi bi-fire), version 1.11.3, used throughout the KFV Freising sitepackage for iconography.

nodes.label: KFV Freising Brand Identity
nodes.description: The touch icon represents the KFV Freising (Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising) brand: a red flame symbolizing fire department identity, used as PWA/mobile app icon.
